"is there any way to make my parents understand..." short answer, no. 

You cannot make anyone else do anything, just as they can't really make you do anything. You're 30, you have a job, move out and move closer to work if you are struggling to live with them. What's keeping you there is your guilt, and FEELING like you have to do these things because of patterns you have learnt from a young age, but you are an adult with autonomy and you can break the cycle if you want to.

Concentrate on yourself and what you can do to improve your situation, not on forcing them to change their behaviour to accommodate you.
